footnote_text: This security represents restricted stock units ("RSUs"). Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of  Common Stock of the Issuer. The vesting schedule of the RSUs shall be: thirty-three percent (33%) on April 1, 2027, thirty-three percent (33%) on October 1, 2027, and thirty-four percent (34%) on April 1, 2028, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service with the Issuer through each applicable vesting date.
